reviews.author: Lara Cosette Fajardo
reviews.text: I had a great experience at this clinic! I showed up even before their official opening time, but Dr. Jafferi was kind enough to welcome me right away. I got my wisdom tooth extracted and was honestly surprised by how painless and smooth the procedure was. Dr. Jafferi was exceptionally kind, gentle, and reassuring throughout the entire process. On top of the high-quality care, the prices were very reasonable and affordable compared to other places. I was in so much pain and just wanted my wisdom tooth removed immediately, so I didn't even have a chance to snap a photo of the place. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a skilled and caring dentist! 💯♥️
